title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance. High-quality simulations, however, are difficult to build, requiring instructor input, scenario design, character development, scaffolding, technical implementation, and repeated revision. This paper presents Primer, an open-source, LLM-agnostic AI-supported system that helps educators create adaptive educational simulations. Educators contribute their knowledge of the subject, lesson, and students, while generative AI produces responsive variations of practice for students. Primer uses a multi-agent system centered around executing educator's instructional intent through the entire learning experience. translated_title: Primer：一个以教师为中心的教育模拟创建AI框架
translated_abstract: 教育模拟是一种成熟的教学技术，为学习者提供应用知识、应对挑战和反思自身表现的机会。然而，高质量的模拟难以构建，需要教师投入、场景设计、角色开发、脚手架搭建、技术实现以及反复修改。本文提出了Primer，这是一个开源的、不依赖特定大语言模型（LLM-agnostic）的AI支持系统，旨在帮助教育工作者创建自适应的教育模拟。教育工作者贡献他们对学科、课程和学生的知识，而生成式AI则为学生生成响应式的练习变体。Primer采用多智能体系统架构，核心在于在整个学习体验中贯彻并执行教育者的教学意图。我们希望通过将Primer作为开源系统发布（包括其提示词和GitHub仓库），为自适应模拟设计的开发与研究提供基础。
tldr: 本文提出开源AI框架Primer，通过以教师教学意图为核心的多智能体系统，帮助教育工作者便捷创建自适应教育模拟，降低高质量教育模拟的构建门槛。
en_tdlr: Primer is an open-source, LLM-agnostic multi-agent AI framework that enables educators to create adaptive educational simulations by executing their instructional intent throughout the entire learning experience.
